title: GoVibe Node Execution Contract v1
description: ADR-029 §5: the mandatory schema-enforced contract every dispatched node (one subagent invocation bound to a roadmap Task ID) must carry. Generated by scripts/mcp/runtime/node-contract-generator.mjs from a plan source Task Container; never hand-typed.

node_id.description: Identity of this dispatched invocation. Distinct from task_id so the same task can be redispatched across retries without colliding node identities.

task_id.description: Binding to the roadmap Task ID (WorkflowTaskNode.id / Task Container task_id) this node executes.

path.description: Repo-relative plan source the contract was generated from.

inputs.description: Edges: concrete artifact paths or referenced payloads this node reads before it may start.

outputs.description: Edges: concrete artifact paths this node must produce. An empty array is valid only when exit_gate.commands independently proves completion.

acceptance_criteria.description: Testable Given/When/Then statements, carried over verbatim from the source Task Container's definition_of_done.

exit_gate.description: The deterministic command(s) whose pass/fail closes the node (ADR-029 §5). No LLM judgment substitutes for this.

evidence.description: Populated after the gate runs. A node with passed=false or an absent evidence.recorded_at has not closed, regardless of what any narrative claims.

command_output_ref.description: Where the raw command output is recorded (log path, CI run URL, or similar) — command output, not assertion.

retry.description: STD-SLM-Tiered-Routing §5.3/§6: a failed exit_gate escalates exactly one tier rung, never two, never silently.

escalation.description: The tier this node starts at; on failure the next attempt moves to exactly the next rung in T0 -> T1 -> T1.5 -> T2 -> T3.

policy.description: ADR-029 §5: a deterministic exit_gate failure returns the work to the same executor with the tool output attached; reviewers above L0 may pass or escalate, never silently rewrite.

ref.description: Artifact path or payload reference carried by this edge.
